blocks.text: ILAGAN, Isabela—Isabela province’s economy grew by 4.2 percent in 2025, which was slower than the 6.4-percent registered in 2024. The figure indicates a decrease of 2.2 percent. This is according to the 2025 Economic Performance of Isabela Report on Tuesday (September 29) at the Amphitheater at Isabela Provincial Capitol in Barangay Alibagu. Isabela’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) was estimated at P218.9 billion, representing more than P124,000 per capita GDP. The numbers come from Julius Emperador, Isabela chief statistician of the Philippine Statistics Authority.
